title: list_reviews input
description: Reviews across the portfolio. state overdue: due with a due date before today; due: every due review (dueWithinDays narrows it to those due within that many days, overdue included); done; cancelled; all. mineOnly keeps the reviews that are the caller's to do: on an application they own, or whose outcome decision (C24 Produces Decision Type) they may propose through a product role (C31), as get_my_queue decides. No tool marks a review done yet. Writes nothing.

dueWithinDays.description: With state due: only reviews due within this many days from today, overdue included.

portfolioId.description: Only reviews of applications in this portfolio or below it.

mineOnly.description: True keeps only the reviews that are the caller's to do.
